language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, i am Chip!
Welcome to Russia and welcome to my toy store! Russia is the largest country in the world.
Sometimes I have a hard time figuring out if it’s daytime or nighttime. Can you help?
Look, I have two types of blocks here: a blue one with a sun, that’s daytime.
And a black one with a moon and star, that’s night time.
Now, let’s look at my little TV here. You see? That child is sleeping.
Let’s think. Do you sleep during the daytime, when the sun is out? I don’t think so.
I'll pick the black block with the moon. Because I sleep at night.
What about you? Hey, now the TV shows a eating child. Ha! That’s easy!
I don’t eat at night! I eat during the day! I'll pick the blue block with the sun.
Hm. Now, I see  a soccer ball. Soccer usually makes me really tired, but do I play it at night?
No, I don’t! I play during the daytime. I'll pick the blue block with the sun.
That’s a bed! Let’s see. I usually sleep in my bed. When do I sleep? I sleep during the night time! Yes!
I'll pick the black block with the moon. Great! That’s that!
